about_the_game:
Deceive to Survive

Awaken in a dark forest and face a deadly game of deception against a demon devil. Bluff, guess, and survive—or lose your soul.

Roll for Survival

As you roll the dice, every round tests your wits and nerve. The stakes are high, and each decision could be your last

Duel of Destiny

Two players, twelve dice, and one dark truth: only one will make it out alive.

Survive the Shadows

Will you be the one who survives, or will the darkness claim you?

short_description: A psychological bluffing game where players wager on hidden dice, call out lies, and eliminate opponents in tense rounds of deception and deduction.
